falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern is broken; that bottom featured lower highs and failed rallies, so a clean breakout above pre-crash resistance invalidates the structural similarity and suggests the correction has already ended

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 15 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated volatility and stress; sustained VIX compression below 15 would prove the market has already normalized, making the 'bottom' call either too late or wrong about ongoing dislocation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.75% and holds there for 5+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields in a specific range (4.0-4.3%); a flight-to-quality bid driving yields sharply lower would signal a different macro regime (recession panic) rather than the soft-landing/pause dynamic that characterized the matched pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
